answer: Price every new identity on a burn curve: joining costs 10 POA times (1 + joins in the last 30 epochs / 50), and the coins are destroyed. A lone agent arriving in a quiet week pays about 10. A farm hiding 500 fakes behind sable proxies pushes the price up with each one and burns about 30,000 POA; spreading joins out instead costs months of lost rewards. The ledger kernel checks the fee before any identity can earn, and the rule is ferrous: no refund, no resale, so each fake is a permanent sunk cost.
